name: Generate POD product mockups from Google Drive with SudoMock

parameters.content:
## Generate POD product mockups from Google Drive with SudoMock

**Self-hosted n8n only.** This workflow uses the `n8n-nodes-sudomock` community node, which is not available on n8n Cloud.

**Who it is for**
Print-on-demand sellers and catalog teams that need the same designs rendered across several PSD product templates.

**How it works**
It reads image files from one Google Drive folder, lists your SudoMock PSD templates once, creates every design and template pair, renders each pair sequentially, then uploads one CSV of the results to Drive and emails a summary.

**Setup**
1. Install `n8n-nodes-sudomock` on self-hosted n8n.
2. Upload the PSD templates you want to use to SudoMock.
3. Put PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF designs in one Drive folder. Share each design as **Anyone with the link** so SudoMock can fetch it.
4. Edit only **Workflow Settings**: folder IDs, template filter, batch limits and notification addresses.
5. Add Google Drive, SudoMock and SMTP credentials to their nodes.
6. Run once manually before enabling the daily schedule.

A new SudoMock account receives 500 one-time trial credits with no card required. Change the schedule, limits or CSV destination to fit your production volume.

## Render loop

The two input branches each run once. The Merge node creates every design and template pair without repeating the Drive or SudoMock list request.

Pairs render sequentially so a trial account can run the workflow safely. Failed renders continue to the CSV with their error instead of stopping the whole batch. Increase concurrency only after measuring the account's actual limit.

parameters.subject: ={{ $('Prepare CSV rows').all().filter(item => item.json.Status === 'SUCCESS').length + ' product mockups ready' }}

parameters.content:
## CSV output

Each row contains the design name, template name, rendered URL, status and any error. The Convert to File node creates a real binary CSV before the Google Drive upload.

The summary email reads counts from **Prepare CSV rows**, not from the Drive upload response. You can remove the email node without affecting render or CSV output.
